besluite.fout: 'So 'n pleknaam ... die plek so genoem het' repeats 'so' clumsily within one sentence.
besluite.rede: The proposal removes the awkward repeat with the same meaning (who named the place) and touches no protected wording.
'iets vertel van' is natural, standard Afrikaans; swapping to 'oor' is a lateral preposition move with no gain.
Same lateral 'van' to 'oor' swap as change 2; the original reads well.

besluite.fout: The phrase 'lank voor nuwelinge uit ander lande' wedged before the verb makes the definition heavy for a Grade 5 reader.
besluite.rede: This rewords a glossary definition and adds 'gekom het', so the writer must decide any fix for all lessons that share it.
